title: Growing worm
tagline: Eat the numbers. Grow longer. Don’t bump anything.
teaser: Steer a worm around the screen eating numbers. Each one makes you longer, and the room feels smaller.

manPage.synopsis: worm — steer, eat numbers, grow, avoid the walls and yourself.
manPage.description: Michael Toy’s growing-worm game: a tiny, tense exercise in steering that shipped with BSD.

howToPlay: Steer the worm around the screen.
Eat the numbers to grow longer.
Avoid the walls and your own tail.
